### Country-specific policy context

<div class="country-policy-context">Started using the qualitative test in 2019 then between 2020 and 2022 piloted and scaled up the STANDARD G6PD test. Until when the STANDARD G6PD was piloted and scaled up, all male patients were provided low-dose 14-day primaquine (0.25mg/kg/day). All females were treated as G6PD deficient and either provided 8-week primaquine or not provided primaquine at all. Once semi-quantitative tests were implemented the 7-day regimen was provided to G6PD normal males and females.</div>
